Lead a team across multiple hackathon competitions, including the Urban Infrastructure Cascade Simulator — architecting the system, splitting team tasks, and preparing documentation and judge Q&A.

hero.title: LET'S TALK
hero.subtitle: Have an idea? Let's build something amazing together.

faqData.q: What's your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: I specialize in full-stack development — React, SvelteKit, and Node.js/Express on the frontend/backend, paired with MySQL, PostgreSQL/Supabase, and Google Apps Script depending on the project's needs.

faqData.q: Are you available for hackathon or freelance collaboration?
faqData.a: Absolutely. I actively lead team SyntaxSquad across hackathon competitions, and I'm always open to freelance projects, technical collaboration, or cross-disciplinary teamwork.

faqData.q: What's your typical production tech stack?
faqData.a: For web apps, my go-to is React/Next.js or SvelteKit on the frontend, Node.js/Express on the backend, and MySQL or Supabase/PostgreSQL as the database — with structured documentation at every phase.

faqData.q: Do you have experience with real-world management systems?
faqData.a: Yes, I've built several full-stack management systems — from a company EBMS, to a hospital coordination platform, to a gym management system with biometric hardware integration.

faqData.q: How do I start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: The most efficient way is to use the contact form above or reach out directly via email. I'm usually able to respond within 24 hours to discuss how my technical skill set can add value to your initiatives.
